maddeler.e:
ينضجع (form VII)
# يَنْضَجِعُ (yanḍajiʕu) /jan.dˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
# يَنْضَجِعَ (yanḍajiʕa) /jan.dˤa.d͡ʒi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
# يَنْضَجِعْ (yanḍajiʕ) /jan.dˤa.d͡ʒiʕ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْضَجَعَ (inḍajaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
